text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Fuji! Did you like that photo frame?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thanks! The cherry blossoms were 
blooming, so it was really lovely.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
She came to ask me, "Are there any cherry 
blossoms that never scatter?" ...Honestly, 
of all the things to suddenly say.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Because it suits Fuji so well! Air Groove, 
you've seen it too, right? How 
breathtaking Fuji looks standing under the 
cherry blossoms!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...That sleek black coat did look striking 
against the cherry blossoms, though.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! So much that I could just gaze at it 
forever! That's why...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Next time, let's take a photo while you're 
running. It'll be the perfect picture for 
that frame!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
When you put it like that, I can hardly 
say no~. ...Me amidst the cherry blossoms, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As the person directly involved, is it 
hard to imagine what the scene looks like?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Because from the way you two talk about 
it, it sounds like a dreamlike view.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Still, if we're doing this, I'd rather 
capture a much more wonderful view. 
...Like a moment under the cherry blossoms 
where the three of us race with everything 
we've got, something like that!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Nngh! Nice, that's awesome! Right, Air 
Groove? Let's have a race between the 
three of us under the cherry blossoms 
someday!!
